title: Planet Tweaks V2.3.9 ULTRA — PowerToys Input & Crosshair UI + Global Workspace Builder
releaseNotes: PowerToys Input & Crosshair UI: Completely transformed Keyboard Manager into clean, individual PowerToys-style cards with instant 'Remap a key' and 'Remap a shortcut' windows; integrated Custom Esports Crosshair with F10 hotkey. Global Workspace Tab Ordering: Reorder any tab anywhere in the entire app, moving Macros or any mode to the absolute top or bottom across all categories. Dual-Engine Scancode Remapping: Instant 0ms RAM hook alongside permanent ring-0 Windows Kernel Scancode Map (HKLM) for 100% anti-cheat immunity. Macro Calibration: Optimized Elevator 90s with calibrated 18ms real-speed pacing, refined Double Edit and Infinite Edit reset loops, and sub-tick burst modes.
